column2: You got it!!
Miyuki-san!
Jiro-kun!
Whoo-hoo, you two lovebirds!
Those two are fated to be torn apart someday...
How come!?
When the time comes, Doji must return to the Kigoku World. That... is Doji's fate!
But that's...
Take me with you...\n\nI don't care if I die! I don't care how terrifying that world is! If that time ever comes, take me to the Kigoku World too!
Miyuki-san...
Goki, I'm thinking of going with {p}.
Doji, I was about to suggest the same.
Actually... I was thinking the same thing.\n\nJust like Great King Enma said, other worlds in other dimensions really do exist. Worlds like the Kigoku World.
And someday, we must return to that Kigoku World.
Oh, I get it! Jiro's gang and {p}...!
We're in the same boat.\n\nWhy did we show up in this world? How do we get back to our own?
The truth is, I don't want to go to the Kigoku World... But I have to.
I'll follow you anywhere...
Anyway! If {p} and Jiro team up... maybe they can solve each other's mysteries? That's the idea!
I think there's a reason we met like this.
The will of whoever created the Kigoku World... or perhaps something else...
...Something else?
No... I know nothing even of that...
But we've got to solve every one of those mysteries!
That's the spirit, {p}! Well, let's head back to Hell Villa!
Hell Villa?
It's my place!\n\nI'll fix up a room for the two of you!
Grr... Shutendoji! We'll settle this another time!
I just... can't get to sleep...\n\nWhy is that? I've got a bad feeling...
What a pretty moon...\n\nWhen will we ever get back to our own world...
...! Oh no!
Ow! What...!?
You have answered my summons well...
Wh-who's there!?
Who I am... you will learn in time. You shall become mine, and know everything...!
Kyaaa!
What was that scream!?
{s} is gone!
Ah! Over there!
Oh no! We have to get her inside!
The black moon!?
What's up? Whoa, the black moon!? But that's weird, there wasn't any earthquake...
Maybe something new is starting.
Something new...
Hey, what are you doing!? {s} is burning up!
I'm coming!
...In time, you shall be mine...
How is {s} doing?
A whole night's passed and her fever hasn't gone down, and she won't wake up...
I can't tell what's causing the high fever, jaja...
Hell World doctors can't cure human sickness, either...
Wouldn't it be better to have a good doctor look at her somewhere with proper medical equipment?
The black moon's still up in the sky, too.\n\nAnd it's long past dawn...
Wh-what was that!?
Something's falling...!?
Look at that!
Looks like it came down near here!
Oh no! We have to go help!
What the heck is this? A helicopter?
Could this be the person who was riding in it?
Hey, you! Hang in there!
Uhh... nnn...!
...Huh! Wh-where am I...!?
You're in the forest near the Dark Temple in Kyoto. I'm {p}. What's your name?

Koji... Kabuto...

Th-that's right! The black moon!!

*Thud*...!!
He passed out...
...Hey, didn't he just say "black moon"?
Yeah...
Anyway, let's carry him to Hell Villa!
Koji Kabuto-kun is awake!
How's Koji-kun doing...?
Well, it looks like he's from another world too.
The black moon again...?
Seems that way.\n\nLeave things here to me. Go talk with Koji-kun.
Leave things here to me. Go talk with Koji-kun.
{s} still hasn't woken up... Koji-kun is talking with Enma-kun in the Japanese-style room on the first floor.
{s} still hasn't woken up...
Hear that machine's called the Pilder!
I kinda wanna take it for a spin.
That Koji Kabuto-kun must be a lousy pilot! I mean, he crashed the Pilder!
Oh my, but he was going to fight all on his own, wasn't he? How manly and dreamy!
Who's the better-lookin' fella, him or me, I wonder?
Seems his world's got these things called Mechanical Beasts.
They're giant machine beasts, apparently!
Mechanical Beasts, huh...
I hear there's a place called the Photon Power Lab at the foot of Mt. Fuji. When the Kanto Hellquake hit, Mt. Fuji erupted, and that whole area should have sunk into the sea...
I hear there's a scientist named Professor Yumi at a place called the Photon Power Laboratory.
If we ask Professor Yumi, maybe he can cure {s}'s illness!
I believed there was no world beyond this one but the Kigoku World.
I simply fulfill my mission... Nothing else concerns me...!!
So it was you... Thanks for saving me.
I filled him in on most of it.
So when a black moon shows up, worlds get connected? I was sure it was some new enemy weapon.
Dr. Hell leads an army of Mechanical Beasts and is plotting to take over the world. I fight his Mechanical Beast army with the giant robot my grandpa built: Mazinger Z.
Mazinger Z?
It's being repaired at the Photon Power Lab.
I hear there's an awesome scientist there!
You mean Professor Yumi. He was my grandpa's apprentice.
If we go to the Photon Power Lab, can we meet this Professor Yumi?
The professor's not at the lab right now.\n\nHe's attending a conference of the world's top scientists.
